name: rag-golden-representative-smoke
description: Expanded synthetic smoke dataset for representative RAG pipeline verification. Still synthetic and small-sample; suitable for regression/delta checks, not quality claims.
source: Synthetic examples authored for repository baseline testing; no external/customer/regulated documents included.
limitations: Small sample size (10 cases); suitable only for smoke/regression deltas, not quality claims.
Synthetic, plain-text content only; does not cover PDF/HTML/DOCX/EML, OCR, tables, multi-tenant data, or financial-services terminology.
Expected answers/evidence are illustrative and may not capture all acceptable grounded responses.
No human adjudication study; relevance judgments are provisional.
Deterministic mock embeddings/model; not representative of real provider latency, cost, or quality.
